title: Russell and Illinois Jacquet start out as a dance team
summary: The Jacquet brothers began in Houston as dancers, and Cobb recalls root beer jobs paying 75 cents.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: But Russell was in Milt Larkin's band for awhile, wasn't he?
For awhile. But Russell and Illinois

started out in Houston as a dance team; neither one of them could blow a horn. They danced. They had a dance team. We used to play root beer jobs on a platform where people would come in and buy root beer, you know, and we'd get 75¢ a night, and then people would throw money up on the -- for tips.
They would take that money home in tips and give it to their mother.
